title: Mobility Equipment Quality Review Standard — Fault Review on Battery-Set Claims
content:
# Fault Review Allowance — Battery-Set Claims on Mobility Equipment

**Standard.** A fault-review allowance is added to the labor units claimed from the manufacturer for a warranty battery-set replacement on a Mobility Equipment chair, by the number of repair estimate requests on the chair: 2 units for 4 or more, 1 unit for exactly 3, and nothing for fewer.

## Count

The count is every repair estimate request recorded on the chair's wheelchair record, whatever its status.

| Repair estimate requests on the chair | Fault-review allowance |
|---|---|
| 0, 1 or 2 | none |
| exactly 3 | 1 unit |
| 4 | 2 units |
| 5 or more | 2 units |

## Points of the standard

- **Three versus four.** Exactly 3 requests give 1 unit; the fourth request lifts the allowance to 2 units, and further requests do not raise it beyond 2.
- **Hypothetical case.** A chair with two repair estimate requests on file receives no fault-review allowance.
